result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: the bottom pizza card clipped by the tab bar, inconsistent favorite-icon background, and clipped carousel content with truncated restaurant name.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card with -20% badge (pizza) is abruptly cut off by the bottom tab bar with no name, rating or delivery info visible
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area margin so the last card is fully visible above the fixed tab bar and not clipped behind it

issues.description: Favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent: Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a bare white outline heart with no background, while the pizza card below shows a heart inside a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent favorite-button style with a semi-transparent dark circular background to ensure visibility and consistency on all cards

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' with image and text clipped at screen edge
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal list end padding and apply text ellipsis so truncated names are handled gracefully in the carousel
